anonymizeModal.title: Permanent Patient Record Anonymization
anonymizeModal.explanation: In accordance with health data protection regulations and privacy directives, this anonymization procedure will:
anonymizeModal.point1: Permanently shred cryptographic keys for names, phones, addresses, and national IDs.
anonymizeModal.point2: Immediately terminate all active sessions, patient portal accounts, and tokens.
anonymizeModal.point3: Preserve de-identified clinical and PACS imaging studies for ongoing diagnostic validity.
anonymizeModal.confirmCheckbox: I acknowledge and confirm verified data subject identity and take responsibility for irreversible anonymization.

retentionTab.title: Health Data Retention & Compliance Standards
retentionTab.subtitle: Certified regulatory policies for data lifecycle management, de-identification, and anonymization
retentionTab.row1Period: 10 years from last date of treatment
retentionTab.row1Basis: Ministry of Health & National Health Information Center Directives
retentionTab.row2Period: 21 years (or 15 years after reaching age of majority)
retentionTab.row2Basis: Clinical safety standards for minor rights protection
retentionTab.row3Basis: ACR/DICOM imaging standards and healthcare accreditations
retentionTab.row4Basis: National General Tax, Zakat & Accounting Regulations
retentionTab.securityDesc: VIARA employs state-of-the-art cryptographic architecture to protect patient privacy:
retentionTab.sec1: Data at Rest protected by AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption.
retentionTab.sec2: Data in Transit protected by TLS 1.3 with strict HSTS enforcement.
retentionTab.sec3: Immutable SHA-256 chaining for tamper-evident compliance audit trails.
retentionTab.sec4: Isolated demographic field-level encryption for all Protected Health Information (PHI).
